title: FINALLY CAUGHT UP! And I’ve only seen a single show in July… for now ...
transcript: It's time for a June theater recap. And if you just got here from the other two, uh, that's right. I am caught up. Love a non replica production that makes bold directorial choices. What will I do without you? Seeing the notebook is how I wanna spend my days. Celebrating the well deserved Tony wins of a hit 40 years in the making. The sequel to sus I didn't know I needed. New York City Center hits a absolute home run with the final show of the encore series this year. Glad I was convinced to revisit this one. I liked it a lot better the second time. Holly's was the perfect concert and the perfect first time at Carnegie Hall. A mixed bag of a play with stunning direction. The kind of weird art that makes me love this medium. I consistently, really enjoy Alexis Shears writing a lovely revival of a play that absolutely sticks the landing. The kind of transformative revival. I really wanna see more of. It really is that good. Douglas Lines is quickly becoming one of my favorite contemporary playwrights, and I cannot wait to see a full production of this. Keep an eye out for this one.
classificationReason: Explicit monthly recap covering many shows with brief one-line takes on each (The Notebook, Encores finale, a revival, Carnegie Hall concert, etc.). 3+ shows with no single focus.
